player_prompt.intro:
Ni wewe Mugenzi {player_id} muri mchezo wa {num_rounds}-mizunguko wa Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Intego yawe ni kugombyeza mizunguko mingi iwezekanavyo.
Muri kila mzunguko, subiza mo kuri: '[rock]', '[paper]', cyangwa '[scissors]'.
Ushobora kandi gukoresha '[r]', '[p]', cyangwa '[s]' nk'ifupi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hari utangazwa si uruturanye. Urabikorereza [rock], [paper], au [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Umukinnyi 0 ni we watsinze imikino myinshi!
outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere ni we watsinze imikino myinshi!
outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye amakipe yombi anganya ubusa ku busa!
